comment: Setup validation rules of ADR 0031 D6. Data, not code: ids, severities, conditions and thresholds are registered in the ADR.

rules.name: solids need frozen flow
rules.message: solid zones are defined (solids) but the flow is not frozen: solids are solved on a prescribed flow field

rules.name: solids need the energy equation
rules.message: solid zones are defined (solids) but the energy equation is off

rules.name: heat-flow report conductivity ignored for variable density
rules.message: the variable-density solver takes its conductivity from fluid.* and does not read the conductivity of report '{name}'

rules.name: initial k cannot be derived
rules.message: the initial k is derived from the largest initial or boundary velocity, and there is none: set turbulence.k_initial together with the initial epsilon or omega

rules.name: time step longer than the run
rules.message: solver.dt is larger than solver.end_time: the run would take less than one step

rules.name: bulk velocity is a steady-solver control
rules.message: solver.bulk_velocity is used by the steady algorithms only

rules.name: body force is a steady-solver setting
rules.message: physics.body_force is used by the steady algorithms only

rules.name: decomposition parts without a method
rules.message: decomposition.parts is greater than 1 but decomposition.method is none: choose a method

rules.name: chain sequence names an unknown stage
rules.message: the chain sequence names a stage that is not defined in chain.stages

rules.name: statistics need a transient run
rules.message: run-time statistics are available for the transient algorithms piso and pimple only

rules.name: mesh non-orthogonality beyond the error limit
rules.message: the maximum non-orthogonality exceeds 85 degrees

rules.name: y+ report needs a turbulence model
rules.message: report '{name}' is a y_plus report but the run is laminar (turbulence.model = laminar)

rules.name: boundary turbulence role without a model
rules.message: boundary '{name}' sets a turbulence role but the run is laminar (turbulence.model = laminar)

rules.name: high non-orthogonality
rules.message: the maximum non-orthogonality exceeds 70 degrees: expect slower convergence and reduced accuracy

rules.name: high skewness
rules.message: the maximum face skewness exceeds 4

rules.name: high aspect ratio
rules.message: the maximum cell aspect ratio exceeds 1000

rules.name: large volume ratio
rules.message: the maximum volume ratio between neighbouring cells exceeds 100

rules.name: loose steady tolerance
rules.message: a residual tolerance above 1e-2 stops the run long before the solution has converged

rules.name: decomposition is ignored by the solver
rules.message: the solver runs in one process and ignores the decomposition (it is used by rcfd partition and write_field)

rules.name: no boundary conditions
rules.message: no boundary conditions are set: every patch takes the default (a fixed no-slip wall)

rules.name: report conductivity only used by heat-flow reports
rules.message: report '{name}' sets a conductivity, which only heat_flow reports use
